sections.title: Valentine's Day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Valentine’s Day doesn’t need a grand gesture. A table for two, food cooked with care and nobody looking at the clock will do. On 14 February our restaurant and conservatory are laid for couples, with a menu written for the night from our own kitchen, and the evening is yours to take as slowly as you like.

The conservatory is the room to ask for if you’d like a little more privacy: a purpose-built glass room at the side of the house. The restaurant itself is a little livelier. Tell us which you’d like when you book, and whether you’d like flowers on the table or a quiet corner, and we’ll do what we can. The menu and price are confirmed each season, and we’ll plan for allergies and dietary needs when you tell us.

Getting home has an easy answer. Our double rooms are in the hotel, some with the bay windows that give the house its character, each with an en-suite bathroom, a TV, tea and coffee and free WiFi. Book a room with your table and the evening ends with a short walk to bed rather than a taxi, and begins again with breakfast cooked to order where it is part of your rate. Parking is free, and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk.

sections.title: The table, the menu and the morning after

items.title: A table for two
items.text: In the restaurant or the conservatory alongside it. Ask for flowers on the table or a quiet corner when you book and we'll do what we can.

items.title: The menu
items.text: Written for the night and cooked in our own kitchen, with dietary needs planned for when you tell us in advance. Menu and price are confirmed each season.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: A double room in the hotel, some with bay windows, so neither of you has to drive. Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am, and breakfast cooked to order where it is part of your rate.

sections.title: Valentine's dinner: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book a table for Valentine's Day?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry. We’ll confirm this year’s menu and price, hold your table and note whether you’d prefer the restaurant or the conservatory. Tables for two are limited on the night, so book early.
Possibly, to hold the table on a busy night. If a deposit is needed we’ll say how much, when it is due and what our cancellation terms are when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for allergies, or a vegetarian or vegan menu?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan preferences when you book, and the kitchen will plan for them.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we stay the night?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free, and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk. Our double rooms are in the hotel; check availability for 14 February and book your room alongside your table.

sections.title: Book a table for two
sections.text: Tell us you’re coming and we’ll hold your table for 14 February. A double room for the night can be booked online.
